title: He Watched This Drip for 52 Years and Never Saw It Fall

scenes.text: He watched this for 52 years. He still missed it.
It's pitch, a black tar-like substance. It looks solid, but it behaves like a fluid.
In 1927, a professor at the University of Queensland put some in a funnel and waited.
By 2013, only eight drops had fallen. About one every decade.
In 1988, a drop fell while the caretaker left the room for five minutes. In 2000, the webcam failed.
John Mainstone watched for 52 years and never saw a single drop fall.

description:
He watched this for 52 years and still missed it.
The pitch drop experiment at the University of Queensland started in 1927. Pitch looks solid but flows, so only eight drops had fallen by 2013. Caretaker John Mainstone spent 52 years watching and never saw one fall.
Could you wait that long?
first_comment: What would you do if you missed it by five minutes?
